headline: Scaling Content Monetisation Through Digital Growth

highlights: DailyVolume (in ,000) 1,536 Saregama India's Q2FY27 revenue stood at INR 3,143 Mn, up by 36.6% YoY & 19.2% QoQ, above our estimate of INR 2,706 Mn.
Reported EBITDA for Q2FY27 was INR 1,020 Mn, up by 48.28% YoY & 9.3% QoQ, above our estimate of INR 866 Mn.
The EBITDA margin expanded by 255 bps YoY and contracted by 296 bps QoQ to 32.4% in Q2FY27, slightly above our estimate of 32.0%.
PAT for Q2FY27 was INR 642 Mn, up by 46.4% YoY & 23.7% QoQ, well above our estimate of INR 528 Mn.
valuation: The company released 650+ film and non-film tracks across multiple regional languages in Q2FY27, including chartbusters from Telugu and Tamil albums and independent music.
The company continues to target a five-year payback period on new content, followed by a long monetisation cycle.

Outlook and Valuation: Saregama's medium-term growth opportunity is increasingly linked to the monetisation of its expanding music catalogue, improving subscription economics and diversification into artist management, live events and brand partnerships.
watch: Subscription Growth and Digital Monetisation: The outlook is supported by India's paid music subscription opportunity, supported by rising digital consumption and increasing conversion from free to paid platforms.
